audit_scope: Uploaded CP18 PDF extraction/layout and Markdown export, specifically a one-PDF-to-one-Markdown scientific translator with neat mathematics.

findings.title: Mathematical structure is lost before translation

observed.source: f(x)=(x+1)/(x-1) with a horizontal fraction bar
Integral from 0 to 1 of x squared dx = 1/3
A is a two-by-two matrix with rows (1,2) and (3,4), brackets drawn as vector paths

findings.cause: Geometry is retained as provenance but serialized to flat strings. PDF vector fraction bars and matrix brackets are not text items. Baseline grouping and paragraph grouping do not reconstruct a math expression tree.
findings.test_scope: Actual uploaded bundled PDF.js 6.2.108 + normalizeItems + analyzeLayout + createMarkdown(source), executed in Node with documented standard-API and canvas-class shims. PDF source rendered with Poppler and visually inspected. No OCR, translation model or browser UI invoked.
findings.impact: Source preservation and complete text-item coverage do not establish preservation of mathematical meaning. Formula status 'preserved' can preserve an already-flattened expression. Downstream model guardrails cannot reliably recover the source structure from these strings.
findings.required_change: Detect complete math regions and reconstruct validated fraction/superscript/subscript/integral/matrix structure before translation; retain exact source regions for internal verification; include meaningful regression fixtures beyond single-line inequalities.

findings.title: The exporter intentionally does not produce rendered mathematics in the standalone .md
observed: Formula blocks are emitted inside fenced text code blocks.
Existing inline LaTeX '$\hat\beta=(X^TX)^{-1}X^Ty$' is emitted inside backticks, preventing ordinary math renderers from treating it as math.
The normal Markdown download uses withAssets=false. Source image crops and full-page images are included only in the ZIP path, not the standalone Markdown.
For image-only blocks, the standalone Markdown tells the reader to open the original PDF or complete ZIP.
findings.impact: This is a direct product-contract mismatch with the requested upload/press/download-one-.md workflow and neat mathematical writing. It is not repaired by making a ZIP available or adding review warnings.
findings.required_change: Define a single Markdown math format, serialize validated inline/display LaTeX rather than code fences, and test it in named supported renderers. A document with unresolved mathematical structure must not silently be presented as a completed scientific translation.

positive_evidence.result: The actual PDF row containing < and ≤ is now classified as formula; the earlier obvious < versus ≤ routing asymmetry is addressed.

Actual repeated-raster-text PDF has 10 image regions, 57.007% total area, and a readable digital header. All 10 image regions are marked OCR-required. A separate 416-alphanumeric-character header probe also triggers OCR for a large image region.
positive_evidence.limit: This proves detection/planning for these cases, not OCR recognition accuracy or exhaustive handling of every PDF image operator.

positive_evidence.result: validateAssetBudget rejects 17 unique 8 MiB checkpoint/new assets (136 MiB total) with PDF_ASSET_LIMIT. Source passes initialAssets into per-page aggregate validation.
positive_evidence.limit: This is stored asset-byte accounting, not a measurement of peak browser heap.

positive_evidence.result: CP18 keeps source item IDs and bounding boxes and uses a dedicated layout worker with cancellation in browsers. This helps diagnosis and resilience but does not itself reconstruct mathematics.

limitations: No original user scientific journal PDF was included in the current upload; source fixtures are synthetic and must not be represented as a broad accuracy benchmark.

Chromium was installed but the OS rejected its process-singleton socket before the application loaded. Browser validation remains unperformed in this subtask; this is an audit-environment limitation, not evidence of a CP18 app crash.
No translation-model output is attributed to this subtask; another audit agent evaluates the actual models.

The node parser uses a compensated Math.sumPrecise shim for finite font geometry sums and standard Map/Uint8Array helpers missing from Node. It does not patch the uploaded application or bundled PDF.js files.
